claims.statement: PPWR generally applies from 12 August 2026 and imposes packaging sustainability, composition, conformity, and documentation requirements.
Packaging-material suppliers must provide manufacturers the information and documentation needed to demonstrate conformity, while manufacturers retain technical files and declarations.
Demand hypothesis: manufacturers will pay for evidence reuse and forward supply reservations before recycled-content targets tighten.

contrary_evidence: Several implementing methodologies and label details remain staged or product-specific.
Large packaging groups may impose their own supplier portals.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: labs and PPWR advisers will refer clients if the rail reduces repetitive evidence chasing
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 150 manufacturers at 3000 PLN monthly yields 5.4m PLN ARR before capacity fees; 30% EBITDA at a 4x value could exceed 6m PLN in 4-6 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly, with legal conformity decisions retained by manufacturers and qualified advisers
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 75-85% once evidence mappings and supplier onboarding are reusable
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: 20 manufacturers at 3000 PLN monthly cover initial capital in 12-15 months after onboarding costs
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 2000-5000 PLN monthly per manufacturer plus 0.5-1.5% of booked capacity value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every batch, supplier change, annual audit, and forward procurement cycle refreshes the record

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Supplier-to-batch evidence graph, auditor acceptance feedback, and visibility into forward compliant capacity
fingerprint.customer: Plastic packaging manufacturers, importers, brand owners, recyclers, and compounders
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Packaging advisers, testing labs, converters, recycler associations, and ERP implementation partners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Supplier evidence vault, technical-file mapping, change alerts, batch allocation, forward capacity reservations, and audit export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Manufacturer pays per packaging family monthly; supplier or buyer pays a small fee when capacity is reserved
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A packaging producer must substantiate conformity and recycled content while suppliers provide inconsistent evidence and uncertain future volume

founder_fit: Regulation creates a timed validation window

structure.commercial_archetype: Compliance evidence network plus forward-capacity marketplace
structure.control_point: Reusable supplier evidence mapped to each buyer's declaration and reserved production batch
structure.critical_dependency: Recyclers must authorize verifiable data and the final methodology must accept the captured evidence

thesis: Packaging makers collect supplier-authorized recycled-content evidence once, map it into their technical documentation, and reserve future compliant recyclate capacity from verified suppliers. Demand hypothesis: the accepted evidence chain and booked volume, not a generic PPWR checklist, can become the durable control point.
title: Recycled-Packaging Evidence and Capacity Rail
